records.title: Каменное кострище
records.subject: A low uneven open circular camp fire hearth, outer diameter about 1.7 m. Ten large irregular grey-brown stones form a readable ring, a shallow charcoal/ash bed INSIDE the ring, four thick partly charred split logs laid loosely across its middle. The central opening and large log shapes remain clear from above. No flames, smoke, sparks or glowing embers: animated fire will be supplied by the engine. No cooking tripod, surrounding dirt patch, grass, lantern, chairs or extra props. The hearth is a compact standalone physical object.

Neutral diffuse material illumination, no directional cinematic lighting, bloom, rim light, external glow or visible light sources unless the subject is itself an actual lamp. Match the broad painted colour treatment and bevel scale of the original crate, fence and herbal table.

records.title: Походный стол
records.subject: A compact expedition preparation table, 1.6 m wide and 0.85 m deep, height 0.85 m. Heavy dark honey timber trestle legs, broad plank top reinforced at corners with dull iron. One LARGE light cream map covers the central two thirds of the top: just a few thick muted coast/route lines and a simple dot, absolutely NO writing or symbols. Beside the map one simple brass compass without letters, one rolled parchment secured by a leather strap, and two small corked opaque coloured flasks in a low two-hole wooden holder near the far corner. A single empty lower shelf. Tabletop fully exposed, no roof/canopy, no tall racks, no hanging lantern. The map must be the clearest focal surface at 48-degree camp view.

records.subject: The BODY ONLY of a travelling merchant stall: a broad 4 m wooden counter with a stepped low rear display shelf, two compact side shelf bays and a useful empty front counter top. Warm chunky worn timber, a few dull iron corners, solid plank front with open storage cubbies below. Three visibly different display heights, all open to the high camera. Entire counter and shelves are EMPTY so goods can be modularly placed later. No canopy, roof, cloth, posts, goods, flags or heraldry. The footprint is much wider than deep, about 4 m wide by 1.8 m deep, counter height 1.05 m, highest rear shelf 1.6 m. Simple large readable carved boards.

records.title: Задний навес отдельно
records.subject: A freestanding REAR CANOPY MODULE ONLY for a modular travelling merchant stall, all its parts visibly connected. Two tall chunky rear wood posts 2.7 m high, joined by a top crossbar, holding a shallow muted olive canvas lean-to roof 3.8 m wide but ONLY 0.9 m deep. Its raised/open front edge has no valance and no front support posts; triangular sturdy timber rear braces support the shallow overhang. The roof covers only the back 20–25% of the complete future stall; most of a counter would stand IN FRONT outside this shallow canopy. Show the complete two posts down to their bottoms, top beam and broad painted canvas folds. No counter, no goods, no ground, no lanterns. No flags, no loose hanging cloth crossing future merchandise.
